examples.name: Sample — signature cells with signing tabs
paragraphs: Two signature blocks, each a three-cell row. A small red tab reading SIGN▸ sits under "SIGNATURE" in the first cell of each; every cell is otherwise empty.

examples.name: Sample — a tag beside a name line
paragraphs: A small red tab sits at the start of the Name**: line in the signature block, ahead of an otherwise blank ruled line. The tab prints no word, so nothing is added for it; every field in the block is blank.
